gaps.title: Massive sample network, only generic 'quality checks' named -- no temperature monitoring
gaps.detail: 13,930+ pick-up points feed 310+ labs across 28+ countries, moving biological samples (blood, tissue, urine) that degrade with temperature exposure. The company's own site names accreditations (NABL, CAP, ISO9001) and '50+ Quality Checks,' but nothing describes real-time temperature monitoring or deviation alerting during transit -- a real gap for a network this large moving specimens this sensitive.
gaps.gnd_service: Cold Chain Management (ThinxFresh) + Asset Tracking & Monitoring
gaps.based_on: 310+ satellite labs. 7725+ patient service centres. 13930+ pick-up points... NABL, CAP, and ISO9001:2008... 50+ Quality Checks... Quality Checks & Processes on Every Sample.

gaps.title: Barcode tracking confirms identity, not temperature integrity
gaps.detail: Every sample gets a barcode for chain-of-custody tracking through the hub-and-spoke network -- solving 'where is this sample,' not 'was it kept at the right temperature the whole way.' A barcode scan at pickup and another at the lab confirms the sample arrived; it says nothing about what happened to it in transit.
gaps.based_on: Dr Lal PathLabs operates a hub and spoke model... Bar coding samples with unique ID helps the company track every step until the report is finally uploaded onto the system.

pitch.angle: Dr Lal PathLabs runs one of India's largest biological sample networks -- 13,930+ pick-up points feeding 310+ labs across 28+ countries -- moving blood, tissue, and other specimens that degrade with temperature exposure. Its own site names barcode-based chain-of-custody tracking and generic 'quality checks,' but nothing about real-time temperature monitoring during transit. A barcode scan confirms a sample arrived -- it doesn't confirm it arrived at the right temperature. GND's ThinxFresh adds exactly that missing layer: instant deviation alerts and auto-generated compliance records across every pick-up point, not just proof the sample eventually showed up.
pitch.opener: With 13,930+ pick-up points feeding your lab network, your barcode system confirms a sample arrived -- what confirms it stayed at the right temperature the whole way there?
